verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations lets each B2B customer have its own branded, federated (enterprise) connection, with self-service SSO setup, domain-ownership verification, and directory sync via SCIM or Google Workspace (auth0-docs-6, auth0-docs-90, auth0-docs-21, auth0-docs-70). This covers per-org SSO connections and verified domains well, but the pack never explicitly documents just-in-time (JIT) user provisioning for these connections — SCIM sync is shown as the provisioning mechanism, not JIT-on-login. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of JIT provisioning behavior for org SSO connections, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
